channel.title: SnapView Updates
channel.description: Product updates, release notes, and support information for SnapView, a fast Mac photo viewer for RAW files and image review.

item.title: SnapView 3.0.1 — September 14, 2026
item.description: SnapView 3.0.1 fixes Creative Suite navigation, watermark input and placement, Auto Cull review, Save and Save Copy, and compact Edit History.

item.title: SnapView 3.0.0 Released on the Mac App Store
item.description: SnapView 3.0.0 is available on the Mac App Store with Creative Suite Preview, viewer AI enlargement, settings backups, improved navigation, and broader interface translations. Saving edited or AI copies and applying culling decisions require Supporter Pass.

item.title: SnapView v2.7.2 Release Notes
item.description: SnapView 2.7.2 was a Mac App Store hotfix for macOS 14 launch compatibility and printing.

item.title: Get SnapView on the Mac App Store
item.description: Starting with SnapView 3.0, the Mac App Store is the only distribution channel.

item.title: SnapView 3.0 Features
item.description: Explore photo editing, AI-powered first-pass culling, Creative Suite Preview, and the fast RAW, ZIP, folder, and Apple Photos viewer workflow.

item.title: SnapView v2.7.1 Distribution Update
item.description: SnapView 2.7.1 is the final DMG release. SnapView 3.0 and all future updates will be available through the Mac App Store.

item.title: SnapView User Manual
item.description: Learn how to install, browse, compare, rate, and organize photos in SnapView for Mac.

item.title: SnapView Support
item.description: Get SnapView support and learn about the final DMG 2.7.1 release and the move to Mac App Store distribution starting with SnapView 3.0.
